newsitem.title: UK: THE STONE AGE SEX OBSESSION SIDE - DEC 2.
newsitem.headline: THE STONE AGE SEX OBSESSION SIDE - DEC 2.

text.p: Our prehistoric ancestors were just as obsessed by sex as we are, according to an archaeologist who has taken a sweeping look at four million years of passion.
Timothy Taylor argues that masturbation, homosexuality, bestiality and transvestism date back to the early mists of time. Sex has never been just for reproduction, he says.
Graphic proof is offered by a 5,000-year-old Siberian rock engraving of a Stone Age man on skis trying to penetrate an elk.
Black Sea Scythian nomads, made impotent by the constant jolting they received on horseback, wore women's clothing.

"Our species have been around for over 100,000 years with the same underlying curiosities and fascinations about life and death," says Taylor, a lecturer in archaeology at the University of Bradford in northern England.
